content:
[Thinking]
**Preparing LinkedIn post**

The user is looking to create a professional and celebratory LinkedIn post that highlights the year since 2017. It should convey excitement and include a call to action, encouraging others to add implementation details to the GitHub wiki. I want to keep it concise and include a link, possibly some hashtags, and even tag CDS Hooks PMC. I’ll make sure not to fabricate any information, just maintain the right tone. Let's get this done!
[/Thinking]

Excited to share that I’ve joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉

I’ve been working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, and I’m honored to help move the standard forward alongside this talented community. I’m looking forward to contributing to governance, interoperability, and real-world adoption efforts.

If you’re already using CDS Hooks, please add your implementation to the availability list so we can grow our shared visibility and interoperability: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

If you haven’t adopted CDS Hooks yet and want help getting started, I’m available as a freelance consultant to assist with implementation, architecture, or integration.

Thanks to everyone who’s supported my journey with this important standard — excited for what’s next! #CDSHooks #HealthcareIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport
